messages:
maria: Heads up — starting ramp for model v8 tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Proposed slices: global 2% -> 5% over 1h, EU-only 10% for 30m. Plan: enable flag rtv8_rollout_v2 with scope slice=s1 and prefix_cache disabled for this rollout. Guardrails: latency >200ms for 5m OR error_rate >1.5% -> auto rollback. Thoughts?

sam: pinging infra — what's the exact flag key? also need rollout config for the routing service.

maria: flag key: rtv8_rollout_v2. Draft command:
```
redwoodctl feature set rtv8_rollout_v2 --slice global --percent 2 --meta '{"prefix_cache":false, "note":"EU ramp 10%"}'
```
I'll attach the full runbook in Confluence after this thread.

lee: We should watch token latency p50/p95 and kv cache miss rate. Add alert on auth failures. Which dashboards?

sam: I'll add a dashboard: /dashboards/model-v8-canary. Also link to perf test: https://ci.redwood/model-v8/loadtest/123

anjali: oncall here — put @oncall on the PagerDuty runbook. If rollback, prefunding steps? Also: ensure Dedicated pools not affected.

maria: yes @oncall added. Rollback procedure: 1) flip flag to 0% 2) revert routing rules 3) scale up previous model pool 4) alert customers if SLA impacted. I'll post steps.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: infra quotas OK, no conflicting toggles, canary policy PASS :white_check_mark:

lee: small nit — bump EU burst to 12% for 10m to flush cached clients, then back to 10%.

maria: SGTM. I'll schedule at 08:00 UTC and announce in #incidents before flip. :rocket:

sam: LGTM. I'll do the flag toggle at 08:00 and monitor.

anjali: I'll be on standby 07:50-09:30 UTC. :phone:

maria: thanks team — adding to calendar. closing thread once runbook is linked.
